_comment: Human-editable values for the dashboard refresh pipeline. Edit this file in the GitHub web UI (pencil icon) and commit. No code or terminal needed.
_linkedin_followers_note: Fallback used ONLY if the ConnectSafely API cannot return the personal follower count. To update: open Aaron's LinkedIn profile, read the follower number, type it here (digits only, no commas), and commit. When ConnectSafely is working this value is ignored.
_funnel_targets_note: Goal/target line drawn on the funnel view. 'connected' = target number of first-degree ICP connections (Track A). 'intake' = target intake calls booked (Track B). Edit the numbers to match the current quarter's goal.
